nodes.description: Owner address state variable inherited by EphesusToken, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Pending new owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
Owned constructor that assigns msg.sender as owner.
transferOwnership(address) guarded by onlyOwner, sets newOwner.
acceptOwnership() requires msg.sender == newOwner then updates owner and clears newOwner.
Public symbol string of the token ("EPU").
Public name string of the token ("EPHESUS Token").
Public decimals of the token (18).
_totalSupply state variable holding the total token supply.
balances mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances.
allowed mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) holding allowances.
EphesusToken constructor that initializes symbol, name, decimals, total supply and mints to a fixed address.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address) returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address,uint) moves tokens from msg.sender balance to recipient.
approve(address,uint) sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address,address,uint) moves tokens using allowance from msg.sender.
allowance(address,address) returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes) sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Payable fallback that immediately reverts; contract refuses ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint) onlyOwner, makes an external ERC20 transfer call to an arbitrary token contract.
SafeMath.safeAdd performs c = a + b with an overflow require check.
SafeMath.safeSub performs c = a - b with an underflow require check.
SafeMath.safeMul performs c = a * b with an overflow require check.
SafeMath.safeDiv performs c = a / b with a zero-divisor require check.
msg.sender is attacker-controllable caller data used for ownership checks, balance ownership, allowance ownership and as the callback target.
Unchecked-before-require integer addition c = a + b inside safeAdd (0.4.x arithmetic without built-in overflow checks).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender,tokens,this,data) on an arbitrary caller-supplied contract after allowance state write.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner,tokens) to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract address.
Balance state writes inside transfer: balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(...) and balances[to] = safeAdd(...).
Balance and allowance state writes inside transferFrom: balances[from], allowed[from][msg.sender] and balances[to].
Parameter a of safeAdd(uint a, uint b).
Parameter b of safeAdd(uint a, uint b).
Parameter to (recipient) of transfer(address to, uint tokens).
Parameter tokens (amount) of transfer(address to, uint tokens).
Parameter spender of approve(address spender, uint tokens).
Parameter spender of approveAndCall, also used as the external call target contract.
Parameter data (bytes) forwarded to receiveApproval in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token, used as the callee contract address.
Local return variable c of safeAdd holding the raw addition result.

edges.reason: Parameter a is an operand of the raw addition c = a + b.
Parameter b is an operand of the raw addition c = a + b.
The result of the raw addition is assigned into local variable c.
msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender must equal newOwner for acceptOwnership to succeed.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner in transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner in transferAnyERC20Token.
msg.sender determines which balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written in approve.
msg.sender is the spender key used to debit allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes the balance state write in transfer.
msg.sender is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call, coupling caller data with the untrusted call.
approveAndCall performs an external contract call to the spender after allowance state update, enabling reentrancy.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract.
transfer invokes safeSub for the sender balance debit.
transfer invokes safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
Constructor seeds balances[fixedAddress] with the whole supply.
Constructor writes _totalSupply.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned tokens.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
The transfer state update writes into the balances mapping.
The transferFrom state update writes into the balances mapping.
The transferFrom state update writes into the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed allowance mapping before the external call.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
Owned constructor initializes the owner access-control variable.
acceptOwnership transfers the owner access-control variable.
acceptOwnership clears the newOwner pending-owner variable after transfer.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner pending-owner variable.
Recipient parameter to is used as a balance key in transfer.
Amount parameter tokens controls the transferred quantity in transfer.
Unvalidated token amount flows into the raw balance arithmetic in transfer.
Spender parameter is used as the allowance key in approve.
Spender parameter is used as the allowance key in approveAndCall.
Data parameter is forwarded into the approveAndCall processing.
The caller-supplied spender address becomes the target contract of the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress parameter selects the contract operated on in transferAnyERC20Token.
The caller-supplied tokenAddress becomes the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
